hints.title: Layer by Layer Path Transitions
hints.text: Moving from row r to row r + 1, the cost to land on cell (r + 1, c2) depends on previous cell (r, c1) and transition cost.

hints.title: Recurrence Formulation
hints.text: dp[c2] = min(prev_dp[c1] + moveCost[grid[r][c1]][c2] for c1 in range(n)) + grid[r + 1][c2].

hints.title: Row Compression
hints.text: Only the DP values of the immediate previous row are needed to compute the current row.

hints.title: Layered Grid DP Implementation

complexity.notes: Each row transition evaluates n * n transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all n^m paths takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D array of size n stores current row minimum costs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates the row-by-row transition taking cell value as the moveCost index.
